title: 三频折屏 / Spectral triptych
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party composition using existing attributed operators; outbound license pending

descriptions.en-US: Connect an image or text texture. Three shared-mesh screens independently turn and rise with full bass, mid and treble groups. Edit spacing, motion, response and material; the preview stripes are not inserted.
descriptions.zh-CN: 连接图像或文字纹理。三块共享网格的立体屏幕分别随完整低、中、高频段转动和升降。可编辑间距、运动、响应与材质；预览条纹不会插入工程。
